observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached. The camera body has visible wear, including scratches and dust. The lens has a red ring near the front element. The camera is placed on a white cloth with 'McSteve Online Gadget Store' printed on it.

Photo 1: Side view of the same camera, showing the top and front. The camera body shows signs of use, including scuffs and dirt. The lens appears to be a 35mm Nikkor, but the model is not clearly visible.

Photo 2: Top view of the camera, showing the lens attached. The lens barrel has text that appears to say 'Nikon DX' and 'AF-S NIKKOR 35-135mm f/3.5-6.3G ED VR'. The camera body has the Nikon logo and model name 'D7200' visible on the top right. The camera is placed on the same cloth as in previous photos.
All photos show the same camera and lens, with consistent background of a store shelf with boxed electronics.

claims.claim: This is a Used Nikon D7200 DSLR Camera With 35MM Nikkor Nikon Lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 2 show the Nikon D7200 body with a lens labeled 'AF-S NIKKOR 35-135mm f/3.5-6.3G ED VR'. The brand and model are clearly visible on the camera body.
No photo shows the camera powered on or in use. No video or screenshot of operation is provided. The condition of the lens and body cannot be fully assessed from still images alone.

risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter failure, sensor damage, or software issues)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying the image on the screen.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or fungus (especially on the front element)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the front lens element under bright light, showing no haze, scratches, or fungus.

risks.risk: Camera body may have internal damage or moisture damage (e.g., from storage or accident)
risks.proof: Photo of the camera's serial number and a close-up of the sensor area, or a video showing the camera's internal components (if possible).

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the front lens element under bright light.
Photo of the camera's serial number and sensor area.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
